Simulate a Survey and format for DOAS

Source: R/simulation.R
simulate_survey.Rd

Simulates field observer detections across survey sectors with support for detection covariates modeled via p_formula and named coefficients p_betas.

Usage

simulate_survey(
  sim_pop,
  det_p1,
  intra_group_det,
  det_group,
  obs_effect,
  detvar,
  surv_areas,
  p_formula = NULL,
  p_betas = NULL,
  covariates = NULL,
  cov_effect = 0
)

Arguments

sim_pop

A simulated population from simulate_pop (either the returned list or pop$sim_pop).

det_p1

Base detection probability for Observer 1.

intra_group_det

Mean factor for count errors (e.g., 0.9 for undercounting).

det_group

Base detection factor for group size scaling.

obs_effect

Observer 2 relative efficiency (e.g., 0.75 means Obs 2 is 75 percent as effective).

detvar

Standard deviation for detection probability across sectors.

surv_areas

Number of sectors to receive Double Observer surveys.

p_formula

Optional one-sided formula for detection probability (e.g. ~ effort + elevation).

p_betas

Optional named numeric vector of logit-scale coefficients for p_formula (e.g., c(effort = 0.6, elevation = -0.3)).

covariates

Optional data frame of sector-level covariates. If omitted, extracted from sim_pop.

cov_effect

Optional numeric log-odds slope for a single simulated covariate (retained for backward compatibility; equivalent to p_formula = ~ covariate, p_betas = c(covariate = cov_effect)).

Value

A data frame with one row per sector, containing observed counts, Double Observer tallies, and all simulated sector-level covariates ready for input to doas.
